questions.question: Jesus told Martha, the sister of Lazarus, that whoever believes in Him will live even though he dies. True or false?
After Jesus said believers in Him will never die, who did Martha say He was?

answers.text: The Christ the Son of God

questions.question: Before raising Lazarus from the dead, why did Jesus thank the Father out loud?

answers.text: So the people will believe the Father sent Him
So the disciples will learn how to pray
So Martha will stop being afraid
